tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour: buttons, links, highlights, illustrations. White text on it 7.1:1; as text on paper 7.1:1. On purple-tint use purple-dark or purple-ink for text. AAA: darkened from #6b4ef0 in Oct 2026.

tokens.name: purple-dark
tokens.usage: Pressed/hover purple, and purple text on purple-tint where extra weight is wanted. AAA: darkened from #5a3fd6 in Oct 2026 so every text use is 7:1 or better.

tokens.name: purple-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons inside purple-tint chips and tags (6.8:1 on purple-tint). AAA: darkened from #4b34c9 in Oct 2026 so every text use is 7:1 or better.

tokens.name: purple-tint
tokens.usage: Lilac ground. Hero sections, the 'Ages' chip, info-note backgrounds, worksheet headers.

tokens.name: purple-line
tokens.usage: Border of purple chips and panels, hairlines, dotted write-on lines on worksheets.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Second brand colour. Tick circles, telehealth, 'how it works' steps. White text on it passes (5.1:1). AAA: darkened from #007a8a in Oct 2026 so every text use is 7:1 or better.

tokens.name: teal-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons inside teal-tint chips (6.4:1). AAA: darkened from #00606d in Oct 2026 so every text use is 7:1 or better.

tokens.name: teal-tint
tokens.usage: Mint ground. Telehealth chip, photo frame, evidence notes.

tokens.name: teal-line
tokens.usage: Border of teal chips and panels; keeps them distinct in greyscale print.

tokens.name: sun

tokens.name: sun-ink

tokens.name: border-outline
tokens.usage: The outline on every container that holds an icon, label or note: icon tiles, chips, info notes and their badges, step numbers, the side menu. Always in the container's own line colour (purple-line, teal-line, sun-line, pink-line).

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring width (offset by the same amount). Always in the focus colour.

tokens.usage: Keep all text and icons this far inside the trim on home-printed sheets.

tokens.name: safe-margin-book

tokens.name: rule-kid
